copy.tagline: 用900多个工具函数加速Go开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写Go代码，需要常用工具函数库
copy.tagline_en: Accelerate Go development with 900+ utility functions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Go code and need a comprehensive utility library

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你查找和使用 GoUtil 库中 900 多个工具函数，涵盖数组、字符串、文件、CLI、测试等常见编程任务。
howto.when: 当你询问 Go 语言中数组、字符串、文件操作等常见任务的实现方法，或要求推荐 Go 工具库时触发。

say.text: GoUtil 里有没有把字符串转成驼峰命名的函数？
say.note: Claude 会查找 strutil 包并给出示例代码。

say.text: 用 GoUtil 写一个读取文件并统计行数的例子。
say.note: Claude 会使用 fsutil 包生成代码。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you find and use over 900 helper functions from the GoUtil library, covering arrays, strings, files, CLI, testing, and other common programming tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about implementing common tasks in Go (arrays, strings, file operations, etc.) or request recommendations for Go utility libraries.

say_en.text: Is there a function in GoUtil to convert a string to camelCase?
say_en.note: Claude will look up the strutil package and provide example code.

say_en.text: Write an example using GoUtil to read a file and count lines.
say_en.note: Claude will use the fsutil package to generate code.
